other_conditions: The applicant must own and drive an auto‑rickshaw, taxi or maxi‑cab.
The vehicle must be in the possession of the owner and the owner’s name must match the bank account used for payment.
The applicant must possess a valid driving licence for an auto‑rickshaw or light motor vehicle.
The applicant must not be a beneficiary under any other Government of Andhra Pradesh scheme for the same occupational group.
The applicant and family members must not be government employees or pensioners (sanitary workers’ families are exempt).
The applicant and family members must not be income‑tax payees.
Average monthly electricity consumption of the family dwelling unit must be less than 300 units (based on the preceding six months).
The applicant must not own land exceeding 3 acres wet, 10 acres dry, or 10 acres wet & dry combined.
In municipal areas, the family must not own residential/commercial built‑up area exceeding 1,000 sq ft.
The applicant must not be a GSTN holder.
Only one vehicle per family (husband, wife and minor children) is eligible for benefits.
Eligibility is limited to one person per family on a white ration card, even if ownership or licence is in the name of different family members.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹10,000 per annum to self‑owned auto/taxi drivers for insurance, fitness certificates, repairs and related expenses, disbursed via bank transfer or AEPS.
